title: CERN 超級質子同步加速器~CERN Super Proton Synchrotron
focus: 6.9 km 常溫磁鐵同步加速器的磁剛度、200 MHz 射頻、電子雲、慢引出損失與 LHC 注入保護~Magnetic rigidity, 200 MHz RF, electron cloud, slow-extraction losses and LHC injection protection in a 6.9 km warm-magnet synchrotron
summary: 以 SPS 的 744 台常溫偶極磁鐵與 Bρ = 3.3356·p 為起點，理解它如何把 26 GeV/c 質子加速到 450 GeV/c，再把 200 MHz 行波腔與固態放大器、非晶碳鍍膜、線掃描器發射度量測、三階共振慢引出損失預算與向 LHC 轉移的機器保護整合成可驗收的注入器工程。~Starting from the SPS's 744 warm dipoles and Bρ = 3.3356·p, see how it takes protons from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c, then integrate 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities with solid-state amplifiers, amorphous-carbon coating, wire-scanner emittance measurement, the third-integer slow-extraction loss budget and LHC-transfer machine protection into an acceptable injector engineering record.

units.anchor: 744 台主偶極磁鐵~744 main dipole magnets
units.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強~Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV
units.mechanism: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。因為 ρ 被隧道幾何固定，同步加速器必須讓磁場隨動量同步上升，並以射頻頻率鎖住軌道長度；注入端的低場與頂端的高場相差十幾倍，兩端的場品質都要顧到。總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。~The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]. Because ρ is fixed by the tunnel geometry, a synchrotron must raise the field in step with momentum while the RF frequency locks the orbit length; injection and top fields differ by more than a factor of ten, and field quality matters at both ends. The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment.
units.model: 744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。450 GeV/c：Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m，B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T；26 GeV/c 注入：Bρ = 86.7 T·m，B ≈ 0.117 T；400 GeV/c 慢引出：Bρ = 1334 T·m，B ≈ 1.80 T。注入到頂端的場強比約 17.3，電源與磁場量測須在此動態範圍內維持 10⁻⁴ 級再現性。~With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. At 450 GeV/c, Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m and B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T; at 26 GeV/c injection Bρ = 86.7 T·m and B ≈ 0.117 T; at 400 GeV/c slow extraction Bρ = 1334 T·m and B ≈ 1.80 T. The injection-to-top field ratio is about 17.3, and power converters and field measurement must stay reproducible to 10⁻⁴ across that dynamic range.
units.verify: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。~Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp.
units.failure: 若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。~If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.
units.misconception: SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。~The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.

units.anchor: 200 MHz 行波加速腔~200 MHz travelling-wave cavities
units.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學~RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics
units.mechanism: SPS 以 200 MHz 行波腔加速，諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev 決定環上射頻「桶」的數目；LHC 型束流以 25 ns 間隔佔據每 5 個 5 ns 桶中的 1 個。縱向穩定取決於滑相因子 η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²：高於轉變能時，動量較高的粒子繞一圈反而較慢。SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。~The SPS accelerates with 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities, and the harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev sets how many RF buckets fit around the ring; LHC-type beams at 25 ns spacing fill one in every five 5 ns buckets. Longitudinal stability depends on the slip factor η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²: above transition, higher-momentum particles take longer per turn. Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp.
units.model: f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz；h = 4620 時 f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz，桶距 5 ns。26 GeV/c 時 γ = 27.73：Q26（γt = 22.8）η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴；Q20（γt = 18）η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³，約大 2.9 倍。縱向不穩定門檻隨 |η| 上升，因此在相同阻抗下 Q20 可承受更高的束團強度。~f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz; with h = 4620, f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz and buckets are 5 ns apart. At 26 GeV/c, γ = 27.73: for Q26 (γt = 22.8), η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴; for Q20 (γt = 18), η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³, about 2.9 times larger. Longitudinal instability thresholds rise with |η|, so Q20 tolerates higher bunch intensity for the same impedance.
units.verify: 以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較；改變 RF 頻率量測動量壓縮因子以獨立求 γt；在注入平台逐步提高束團強度，記錄束團長度振盪開始出現的門檻。~Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics; obtain γt independently by measuring momentum compaction from RF-frequency steps; raise bunch intensity step by step on the injection plateau and record the threshold at which bunch-length oscillations start.
units.failure: 以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。~Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point.
units.misconception: 轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。~Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.

units.anchor: 疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈~Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils
units.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史~Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history
units.mechanism: SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。鐵芯在 2 T 附近開始飽和，因此 450 GeV 已接近常溫鐵磁鐵的實用上限，這也是 LHC 必須改用超導磁鐵的原因。疊片抑制斜坡時的渦電流，但鐵的磁滯使同一電流下的磁場取決於前一循環的最高場；SPS 在超循環中交錯 LHC、固定靶與其他用戶循環，磁場歷史不斷改變。偶極分為兩種孔徑型式，以配合不同位置的束流尺寸。~The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The iron begins to saturate near 2 T, so 450 GeV is close to the practical limit of warm iron magnets, which is why the LHC had to use superconducting magnets. Laminations suppress eddy currents during the ramp, but iron hysteresis makes the field at a given current depend on the previous cycle's peak; the SPS interleaves LHC, fixed-target and other users in a supercycle, so the magnetic history keeps changing. The dipoles come in two aperture types matched to the local beam size.
units.model: 鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。假設間隙 g = 40 mm、B = 2.02 T：NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ A·匝，接近飽和時鐵的磁阻不可忽略，實際需多出數個百分比。假設剩磁 1.0 mT，相對注入場 0.117 T 佔 0.85%；循環間剩磁變動 1% 時 ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵，在 D = 3 m 處造成約 0.26 mm 軌道偏移。~For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀. Assuming a gap g = 40 mm and B = 2.02 T, NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ ampere-turns, and near saturation the iron reluctance adds several percent more. Assuming a remanent field of 1.0 mT, it is 0.85% of the 0.117 T injection field; a 1% cycle-to-cycle change in remanence gives ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵, an orbit shift of about 0.26 mm where D = 3 m.
units.verify: 以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。~Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes.
units.failure: 冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。~Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop.
units.misconception: 常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。~Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.

units.anchor: 非晶碳鍍膜真空室~Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers
units.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜~Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating
units.mechanism: 25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。~High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3.
units.model: 束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。取 r = 20 mm（假設）、r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m：N = 1.15×10¹¹ 時 ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV；N = 2.2×10¹¹（HL-LHC 型）時 ≈ 0.98 keV。前者恰落在未處理金屬 SEY 峰值的數百 eV 附近，強度翻倍後倍增依然存在，必須以鍍膜把最大 SEY 壓到門檻以下。~An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. With r = 20 mm (assumed) and r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m: N = 1.15×10¹¹ gives ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV, and N = 2.2×10¹¹ (HL-LHC type) gives ≈ 0.98 keV. The former sits right at the few-hundred-eV SEY peak of untreated metal, and doubling intensity keeps multipacting alive, so the coating must hold the maximum SEY below threshold.
units.verify: 鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。~Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance.
units.failure: 鍍膜附著不良或長期暴露潮濕大氣，SEY 回升到 1.2 以上，高強度 25 ns 束串尾端出現垂直不穩定與發射度增長，只能降低強度或延長洗刷運轉，直接壓縮 LHC 可用的亮度。~Poor coating adhesion or long exposure to humid air lets the SEY climb above 1.2, vertical instabilities and emittance growth appear at the tail of high-intensity 25 ns trains, and the only remedies are lower intensity or longer scrubbing runs, directly cutting the luminosity available to the LHC.
units.misconception: 只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。~If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.

units.anchor: 快速線掃描器~Fast wire scanners
units.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算~Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget
units.mechanism: SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。線掃描器以細碳纖維線快速穿過束流，由下游閃爍體量二次粒子簇射得到橫向剖面 σ，再以 ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w 換算，其中 β_w 為量測點的 Twiss β 函數、D·δ 為動量分散造成的寬度。誤差來源包括 β_w 的光學誤差、線速度與位置編碼、線材受熱以及量測點色散的修正。~The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). A wire scanner sweeps a thin carbon fibre rapidly through the beam, a downstream scintillator records the secondary shower to give the transverse profile σ, and ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w converts it, with β_w the Twiss beta at the scanner and D·δ the width from momentum spread. Error sources include optics error in β_w, wire speed and position encoding, wire heating and the dispersion correction at the scanner.
units.model: 450 GeV/c 時 βγ = 479.6；假設 ε_n = 2.0 µm、β_w = 70 m：σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm。若 D = 0.5 m、δ = 3×10⁻⁴，D·δ = 0.15 mm，量得 √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm；忽略色散修正會算成 2.15 µm，高估 7.7%。β_w 的 5% 誤差直接造成 5% 的發射度誤差。~At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm. With D = 0.5 m and δ = 3×10⁻⁴, D·δ = 0.15 mm and the measured width is √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm; skipping the dispersion correction yields 2.15 µm, a 7.7% overestimate. A 5% error in β_w maps directly into a 5% emittance error.
units.verify: 以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。~Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty.
units.failure: 束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。~With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it.
units.misconception: 幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。~Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly.

units.anchor: 靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列~Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array
units.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算~Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget
units.mechanism: 送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。ZS 由五個各長 3.15 m、每個含 2080 根鎢錸細線的槽構成。約 4.8 s 的平頂把約 3.5×10¹³ 顆質子均勻送出，形成實驗所需的長 spill；打在線上的質子造成損失與活化，是慢引出的核心限制。~Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel. The ZS consists of five 3.15 m tanks, each with 2080 tungsten–rhenium wires. A flat top of about 4.8 s spreads roughly 3.5×10¹³ protons into the long spill experiments need, and protons striking the wires cause loss and activation, the central limit of slow extraction.
units.model: 損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。有效寬度 0.55 mm、假設步距 17 mm：損失 ≈ 3.2%；每次 3.5×10¹³ 顆中約 1.1×10¹² 顆打在分離器區，能量 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ，10.8 s 循環平均約 6.7 kW。彎晶遮蔽使損失再降約 40%，比例約 1.9%。~Loss fraction ≈ effective septum width / three-turn step. With a 0.55 mm effective width and an assumed 17 mm step, the loss is ≈ 3.2%; of 3.5×10¹³ protons per spill about 1.1×10¹² hit the septum region, depositing 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ, about 6.7 kW averaged over a 10.8 s cycle. Bent-crystal shadowing cuts the loss by about 40% more, to roughly 1.9%.
units.verify: 以分離器下游束流損失監測器的積分讀值除以引出強度求損失比例，與模型比較；以二次發射監測器的 spill 時間訊號做頻譜分析，檢查 50 Hz 及其諧波漣波與工作因子；改變六極強度或步距後重測損失，確認損失與步距成反比的趨勢。~Divide integrated readings of beam-loss monitors downstream of the septum by the extracted intensity to obtain the loss fraction and compare with the model; analyse the spectrum of the spill time signal from secondary-emission monitors for 50 Hz harmonics and duty factor; repeat the loss measurement after changing sextupole strength or step size to confirm the inverse dependence on step.
units.failure: 電源漣波讓工作點以 50 Hz 與 100 Hz 抖動，spill 出現尖峰，下游偵測器在尖峰期間飽和，有效事件率下降；長期損失使分離器區活化累積，維修前需等待衰減並增加人員劑量。~Power-converter ripple modulates the tune at 50 Hz and 100 Hz so the spill develops spikes, downstream detectors saturate during them and the useful event rate falls; persistent losses accumulate activation in the septum region, forcing cool-down waits and higher personnel dose before maintenance.
units.misconception: 只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。~Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.

units.anchor: TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器~TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators
units.title: 向 LHC 注入：束串能量與機器保護~Filling the LHC: train energy and machine protection
units.mechanism: SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。引出踢磁鐵必須在束串間隙內上升到位，任何時序或強度錯誤都可能讓整串高能束流打到傳輸線或 LHC 注入區，因此傳輸線末端設有可移動的注入保護準直器（TCDI），引出前由互鎖系統檢查軌道、強度與磁鐵電流，並先以低強度探針束驗證路徑。束串的強度與發射度決定 LHC 亮度，也決定出錯時的破壞力。~The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. Extraction kickers must reach full field inside the inter-train gap, and any timing or strength error can steer a whole high-energy train into the transfer line or the LHC injection region; movable injection-protection collimators (TCDI) therefore sit at the end of the lines, an interlock system checks orbit, intensity and magnet currents before extraction, and a low-intensity probe beam validates the path first. Train intensity and emittance set LHC luminosity and also the damage potential of a mistake.
units.model: 一串 4×72 = 288 束團、每束團 1.15×10¹¹ 顆、450 GeV：E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ；LIU 強度 2.3×10¹¹ 時約 4.8 MJ。熔化 1 kg 銅需 385×1058 + 2.05×10⁵ ≈ 6.1×10⁵ J，一串足以熔化約 3.9 至 7.8 kg 銅。LHC 每環 2808 束團約需 2808/288 ≈ 10 次轉移。~A train of 4×72 = 288 bunches of 1.15×10¹¹ protons at 450 GeV stores E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ, and about 4.8 MJ at the LIU intensity of 2.3×10¹¹. Melting 1 kg of copper takes 385×1058 + 2.05×10⁵ ≈ 6.1×10⁵ J, so one train could melt about 3.9 to 7.8 kg of copper. Filling 2808 bunches per LHC ring needs about 2808/288 ≈ 10 transfers.
units.verify: 每次填充前以單一低強度束團走完傳輸線，比對軌道與模型響應矩陣並量測 LHC 注入振盪；定期掃描 TCDI 準直器相對束流的中心與以 σ 計的開口；並以刻意給錯設定的測試確認互鎖確實阻止高強度引出。~Before each fill send a single low-intensity bunch down the line, compare its trajectory with the model response matrix and measure the injection oscillation in the LHC; periodically scan the TCDI collimators to verify their centring and opening in units of σ; and confirm with deliberately wrong settings that the interlock actually blocks high-intensity extraction.
units.failure: 引出踢磁鐵的某個模組未觸發或時序偏移，束串得到錯誤偏角；若保護準直器開口偏大或位置漂移，數 MJ 束流可能打穿真空室並損壞磁鐵線圈，修復需停機數週並延誤 LHC 物理運轉。~If one extraction-kicker module fails to fire or fires late, the train receives the wrong deflection; with a protection collimator opened too wide or drifted, the multi-megajoule beam can pierce the vacuum chamber and damage magnet coils, costing weeks of repair and delaying LHC physics.
units.misconception: 450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。~Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.

units.anchor: 200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環~200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle
units.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收~Multi-user supercycle, RF redundancy and LIU acceptance
units.mechanism: SPS 同時服務 LHC、北區固定靶、HiRadMat、AWAKE 與離子運轉，控制系統把不同循環排成超循環，每個循環有自己的磁場斜坡、射頻程式與引出設定。LIU 升級把 200 MHz 行波腔由 4 座增為 6 座，並由 Thales 交付兩套固態功率放大器：每套 16 座 144 kW 放大塔、每塔 80 個 1.8 kW 功率模組，全系統 5120 顆電晶體，以大量並聯換取優雅降級與高可用度。驗收必須同時證明束流參數與系統可用度達標。~The SPS serves the LHC, North Area fixed targets, HiRadMat, AWAKE and ion runs, and the control system arranges their cycles into a supercycle, each with its own field ramp, RF programme and extraction settings. The LIU upgrade increased the 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities from four to six and Thales delivered two solid-state transmitters, each with sixteen 144 kW amplifier towers of eighty 1.8 kW RF modules, 5120 transistors in all, trading massive parallelism for graceful degradation and high availability. Acceptance must demonstrate both beam parameters and system availability.
units.model: N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。每座 80 模組的放大塔失去 1 個模組：144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW，僅降 2.5%；全系統 2560 模組總額定 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW。固定靶循環 10.8 s 中平頂 4.8 s，工作因子 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%；超循環插入 LHC 填充循環時，北區平均強度按時間比例下降。~An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)². An 80-module tower losing one module gives 144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW, only 2.5% less; the 2560 modules total 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW rated. A 10.8 s fixed-target cycle with a 4.8 s flat top has a duty factor of 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%, and inserting LHC filling cycles into the supercycle lowers North Area average intensity in proportion to time.
units.verify: 逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定；束流端以與 LHC 要求並列的表格驗證每束團強度、發射度、束團長度與束串間一致性；統計一個運轉期的射頻故障停機時數計算可用度。~Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation; on the beam side verify bunch intensity, emittance, bunch length and train-to-train consistency in a table beside the LHC requirements; tally RF fault downtime over a run to compute availability.
units.failure: 冷卻水或電源的單點故障同時切掉多座放大塔時，並聯冗餘失效，腔電壓不足使高強度束流在斜坡中失捕而損失；排程若只追求北區強度而壓縮 LHC 循環，填充延遲，整體物理產出反而下降。~A single-point cooling or power fault that drops several towers at once defeats the parallel redundancy, cavity voltage falls short and high-intensity beam is lost from the bucket during the ramp; a schedule that squeezes LHC cycles to maximize North Area intensity delays fills and lowers total physics output.
units.misconception: 固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。~If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.

example: 斜坡設計練習：SPS 周長 6911.5 m、ρ = 741.3 m，從 26 GeV/c 加速到 450 GeV/c，Bρ 由 86.7 增到 1501 T·m，B 由 0.117 增到 2.02 T。假設平均斜率 Ḃ = 0.2 T/s：斜坡時間 = (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s；每圈能量增益 ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV；f_rev = 43.38 kHz，斜坡約 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ 圈，4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV，與 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c 的動量增量一致。若可用射頻電壓為 7 MV（假設），同步相位 sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146，φs ≈ 8.4°，仍保留足夠的桶面積；把 Ḃ 提高到 0.4 T/s 則 ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV、sin φs ≈ 0.29，桶面積明顯縮小，大強度束流更易失捕。數值為教學假設，不代表實際運轉設定。~Ramp-design exercise: with C = 6911.5 m and ρ = 741.3 m, accelerating from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c raises Bρ from 86.7 to 1501 T·m and B from 0.117 to 2.02 T. Assuming an average Ḃ = 0.2 T/s, the ramp lasts (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s; the energy gain per turn is ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV; at f_rev = 43.38 kHz the ramp spans about 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ turns, and 4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV matches the 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c momentum gain. With 7 MV of RF voltage (assumed) the synchronous phase is sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146, φs ≈ 8.4°, leaving ample bucket area; raising Ḃ to 0.4 T/s gives ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV and sin φs ≈ 0.29, visibly shrinking the bucket so high-intensity beam is more easily lost. Values are teaching assumptions, not operational settings.
history: SPS 於 1976 年啟用，周長約 7 km、最初能量 400 GeV，成為 CERN 粒子物理計畫的主力。1981 年起它改裝為質子—反質子對撞機 SppS，1983 年 UA1 與 UA2 實驗在此發現 W 與 Z 玻色子，Rubbia 與 van der Meer 於 1984 年獲諾貝爾物理獎。1989 至 2000 年 SPS 為 LEP 加速電子與正子，2008 年起成為 LHC 的最後一級注入器，並在 2019–2020 年 LS2 期間完成 LIU 升級。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~The SPS started up in 1976 with a circumference of about 7 km and an initial energy of 400 GeV, becoming the workhorse of CERN's particle-physics programme. From 1981 it was converted into the SppS proton–antiproton collider, where the UA1 and UA2 experiments discovered the W and Z bosons in 1983, earning Rubbia and van der Meer the 1984 Nobel Prize in Physics. From 1989 to 2000 it accelerated electrons and positrons for LEP, since 2008 it has been the last injector of the LHC, and the LIU upgrade was completed during LS2 in 2019–2020. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
